`r descr_models("ordinal_reg", "orm")`

## Tuning Parameters

```{r orm-param-info, echo=FALSE}
defaults <-
  tibble::tibble(
    parsnip = c("ordinal_link", "penalty"),
    default = c("logistic", "0")
  )

param <-
  ordinal_reg(
    ordinal_link = character(0),
    penalty = double(0)
  ) |>
  set_engine("orm") |>
  make_parameter_list(defaults)
```

This model has `r nrow(param)` tuning parameters:

```{r, orm-param-list, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
param$item
```

`ordinal_link` is passed to the native `family` argument and `penalty` is
passed directly to the native `penalty` argument.

## Translation from parsnip to the original package

`r uses_extension("ordinal_reg", "orm", "classification")`

```{r orm-oreg}
library(ordered)

ordinal_reg(
  ordinal_link = character(0),
  penalty = double(0)
) |>
  set_engine("orm") |>
  translate()
```

The wrapper checks the installed `rms` version before fitting.
